subtitle: Chicago Bears at Atlanta Falcons
description:
The Atlanta Falcons host the Chicago Bears at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in an NFC game. Chicago looks to D'Andre Swift to establish the ground attack, while Atlanta relies on Bijan Robinson on rushing downs after his strong early October touches.
2026-2027 at Mercedes-Benz Stadium

title: NFL Football
subtitle: Pittsburgh Steelers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers
description:
The Tampa Bay Buccaneers host the Pittsburgh Steelers in NFL Week 6 at Raymond James Stadium. Tampa Bay (1-4) ended their four-game skid by beating Dallas behind 165 rushing yards from Bucky Irving. Pittsburgh (3-2) beat Indianapolis 34-22 last week.
2026-2027 at Raymond James Stadium

description:

title: NFL Football
subtitle: Dallas Cowboys at Green Bay Packers
description:
The Green Bay Packers host the Dallas Cowboys in NFL Week 6. Last week, Green Bay beat Chicago, 31-7, and is on a two-game winning streak. Dallas is coming off a 24-16 loss to Tampa Bay, with QB Dak Prescott leading the offense for the Cowboys.
2026-2027 at Lambeau Field

title: NFL Football
subtitle: Washington Commanders at San Francisco 49ers
description:
The San Francisco 49ers host the Washington Commanders in Week 6 at Levi's Stadium. San Francisco beat Seattle, 32-29, to maintain their unbeaten streak. The Commanders tied with the Giants after overtime, stopping a multi-game slide with the draw.
2026-2027 at Levi's Stadium
